collection.title: Suzuki S-Cross 2021 to 2025 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Suzuki S-Cross 2021 - 2025 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 13" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
